name: Fabric Data Warehouse
sku: The Fabric warehouse item and the SQL analytics endpoint of the lakehouse, on a Fabric capacity.

store.warehouse.note: An enterprise-scale relational warehouse on a data lake foundation, for star or snowflake schemas and curated data marts. Storage and compute are separated, and it supports full multi-table ACID transactions.

serve.query-engine.note: Queried in T-SQL on an autonomous distributed engine with no tuning knobs, including cross-database queries across warehouses, mirrored databases and lakehouse SQL endpoints.

transform.sql-transform.note: Developed primarily in T-SQL, with stored procedures, functions, materialized views and CTAS or INSERT..SELECT to transform data in place.

store.table-format.note: Data is natively stored as Delta tables, Parquet files with a file-based transaction log, and replicated automatically to OneLake Files for external access.

ingest.batch-extract.note: Bulk loading through COPY INTO, pipelines and dataflows, or Spark writing directly to the Delta tables. It loads data handed to it and does not pull from source systems itself.

bands.note: Permissions can be managed on objects in the SQL analytics endpoint, alongside OneLake security for the SQL analytics endpoint.

presentation.tagline: T-SQL lake warehouse on Delta tables, integrated with Power BI.
